messages:
maya: Heads-up: canary in us-west started showing tokenizer mismatch errors after SDK 2.8.0 -> 2.9.0 rollout. Not huge yet but failing ~2% of requests with invalid-bpe on quantized models. anyone seeing this?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: 2.9.0 rollout -> canary (us-west) at 1725554442. 12/100 instances healthy.
sarah: saw the same on a repro trace, attaching short dump.
sarah: ```
error: invalid-bpe-token at encoder.cpp:214
model: llama-q-v3b
sdk_version: 2.9.0
backend: runtime-3.6.1
stack: kvcache->tokenizer->encoder
```

kev: 2% is concerning for customer-facing. Recommend quick triage and revert if we see spread to eu-west.

maya: agree. can we do a targeted soft-pin (canary -> soft-unpin for 2.9) while we triage? don't want full rollback if it's just tokenizer parity with quant kernels.

deploy-bot: Pin action available: `deploybot pin sdk 2.8.0 --scope canary --region us-west --dry-run`

sarah: quick notes: repro only with quantized kernels built with AVX512 fallback on a minor kernel optimization in 2.9.0 — theory: new packing changed byte alignment causing BPE table read offset on some instances.

ops-bot: Runbook snippet: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sdk-pin-checklist 
ops-bot: Suggested steps: 1) mark canary as paused 2) apply soft-pin 3) collect telemetry for 1h 4) decide rollback vs fix.

nicolas: Change window? We have a maintenance window tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC but prefer not to wait that long. Ops + runtime, propose immediate soft-pin and continue analysis. I'll notify support & customers if we escalate.

kev: +1 to immediate soft-pin in canary region only. If 0->1% decrease after pin, keep progressing. If spread, escalate to full rollback.

maya: executing dry-run now, then patch.
maya: `deploybot pin sdk 2.8.0 --scope canary --region us-west` -> running

deploy-bot: Action queued: pin sdk 2.8.0 on 12 canary instances (us-west). ETA ~30s.

deploy-bot: Action complete: pin applied to canary (us-west). Instances reporting sdk_version=2.8.0: 12/12.

sarah: telemetry delta after ~10m: invalid-bpe errors dropped from 2% -> 0.1% on pinned canary. Non-pinned regions unchanged.

kev: that's a strong signal. recommend holding the global rollout and schedule a rollback plan for eu-west if we see drift.

nicolas: I'll open a release note and incident-prep doc. tagging support.
nicolas: Release note draft: "SDK 2.9.0 rollout paused due to tokenizer parity issue affecting quantized models; soft-pin applied to canary (us-west). Investigation ongoing. ETA next update in 60m."

maya: adding to changelog: affected models: llama-q-v3b, llama-q-v4a (long-seq fallback).

ops-bot: Telemetry alert: if invalid-bpe > 0.5% in any region, deploy-bot will auto-trigger partial rollback to 2.8.0 after confirmation by ops oncall.

kev: also want a short repro script to add to the SDK tests. sarah, can you push a test that runs on quant kernels with AVX flags?

sarah: on it, will PR to sdk-integration with the failing seed + dataset.

maya: summary: soft-pin applied to canary us-west, global rollout paused, telemetry looks positive. next update in 45-60m or earlier if conditions change.

nicolas: noted. I'll notify enterprise customers on the pinned models and update the status page. :eyes:
